title: update_client

x-http.notes: Target resolved by name via Search Clients first (data-model.md Client Resolution) - client_id is never a caller-supplied parameter. Sends a partial payload containing only the fields being changed (research.md Decision 3 - assumption to confirm in Phase 1 RED). Requires explicit approval (require_approval.always) - Feature 022's mechanism extended, not new. Output MUST NOT include the internal client_id (REQ-CLIENT-018).

name.description: Current name used to resolve the target client (required, identifies WHICH client - not necessarily what's being changed).

email.description: Optional: new email. Validated via EmailStr/email-validator before any network call.

phone.description: Optional: new phone. Normalized to Israeli local dashed format (0XX-XXXXXXX) before being sent to Morning.

tax_id.description: Optional: new tax_id. No client-side format check (Morning validates server-side).

x-validation: At least one of new_name/email/phone/tax_id MUST be present - a call changing nothing is rejected as invalid.
